name: San Lorenzo (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Quartered: the upper hoist and lower fly quarters yellow, the other two striped horizontally red and yellow.
history: San Lorenzo is a town and municipality of Puerto Rico located in the eastern central region, north of Patillas and Yabucoa; south of Gurabo; east of Caguas and Cayey; and west of Juncos and Las Piedras.

features.role: stripes of red and yellow in the second and third quarters
